types.float: number, PCell TypeDouble; sent as Magic's default string when equal to it, else rounded to 12 significant digits and written like a Python float
types.int: count (nf, ng, m, nx, ny, turns), PCell TypeInt
types.bool01: checkbox, PCell TypeBoolean, sent as 1 or 0
types.signed: coverage whose first character Magic reads as an anchor (+, - or none); PCell TypeString, sent verbatim when it is a decimal number with an optional + or - and optional whitespace, refused otherwise
types.choice: selectlist other than the device-type switch; PCell TypeString with Magic's choices, sent verbatim when it is one of them, refused otherwise
types.numlist: a number, or one number per layer separated by spaces (IHP via nxcuts, nycuts); PCell TypeString, sent verbatim when every element is a decimal number, refused otherwise
types.string: other text entry, PCell TypeString, sent verbatim
types.enum: the device-type switch (gencell) or a selectindex; not a PCell parameter
types.readonly: dialog message; not a PCell parameter
types.internal: no dialog widget; not a PCell parameter, Magic's default is used
